verdict.rationale: Cake Equity offers a read-only MCP integration for querying the cap table (docs-11, docs-12, docs-27) and built-in vesting automation for cliffs/schedules (docs-4), but there is no evidence of user-configurable automations or agentic workflows that run autonomously in the background—MCP access is explicitly read-only and no scheduling/trigger/agent-loop capability is documented.
